model_annotation: Figure 2 presents two bar charts comparing inference times for different language models at varying batch sizes. The x-axis, labeled “Batch size,” uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 512, with tick marks at intervals of 16. The y-axis, labeled “Inference time (seconds),” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10 seconds. In subfigure (a), titled “1B Models,” three bars are shown for each batch size: blue for Llama-1B, orange for Llama-1B, and red for MambaLlama-1B. The inference times for these models are shown as follows: at batch size 1, Llama-1B takes 0.6 seconds, Llama-1B takes 0.3 seconds, and MambaLlama-1B takes 0.6 seconds; at batch size 16, Llama-1B takes 0.3 seconds, Llama-1B takes 0.3 seconds, and MambaLlama-1B takes 0.3 seconds; at batch size 32, Llama-1B takes 0.3 seconds, Llama-1B takes 0.3 seconds, and MambaLlama-1B takes 0.3 seconds; at batch size 64, Llama-1B takes 0.3 seconds, Llama-1B takes 0.3 seconds, and MambaLlama-1B takes 0.3 seconds; at batch size 128, Llama-1B takes 0.3 seconds, Llama-1B takes 0.3 seconds, and MambaLlama-1B takes 0.3 seconds; at batch size 256, Llama-1B takes 0.3 seconds, Llama-1B takes 0.3 seconds, and MambaLlama-1B takes 0.3 seconds; and at batch size 512, Llama-1B takes 0.3 seconds, Llama-1B takes 0.3 seconds, and MambaLlama-1B takes 0.3 seconds. In subfigure (b), titled “3B Models,” three bars are shown for each batch size: blue for Llama-3B, orange for Llama-4B, and red for MambaLlama-3B. The inference times for these models are shown as follows: at batch size 1, Llama-3B takes 0.6 seconds, Llama-4B takes 0.6 seconds, and MambaLlama-3B takes 0.6 seconds; at batch size 16, Llama-3B takes 0.6 seconds, Llama-4B takes 0.6 seconds, and MambaLlama-3B takes 0.6 seconds; at batch size 32, Llama-3B takes 0.6 seconds, Llama-4B takes 0.6 seconds, and MambaLlama-3B takes 0.6 seconds; at batch size 64, Llama-3B takes 0.6 seconds, Llama-4B takes 0.6 seconds, and MambaLlama-3B takes 0.6 seconds; at batch size 128, Llama-3B takes 0.6 seconds, Llama-4B takes 0.6 seconds, and MambaLlama-3B takes 0.6 seconds; at batch size 256, Llama-3B takes 0.6 seconds, Llama-4B takes 0.6 seconds, and MambaLlama-3B takes 0.6 seconds; and at batch size 512, Llama-3B takes 0.6 seconds, Llama-4B takes 0.6 seconds, and MambaLlama-3B takes 0.6 seconds.
